authority: The operator explicitly requested the single calibration/coverage feasibility audit admitted by DCTRL-000045. This is not adoption of a cross-source comparison or a new model.
question: Under the unchanged CLK002 model, can primary owner sources establish an operational solar-potential calibration law and coverage-qualified error sets adequate for a solar Rb/Cs versus Earth TiAlV/PtRh comparison?
preserved: CLK002 EM-only massless unscreened static first-response action, Rb87/Cs133 hyperfine ratio, actual SUEP alloy pair, imported metric proper time, no Markov reinterpretation, no lattice/volume/continuum limit. Original same-source contract remains unchanged; the cross-source alternative stays not adopted.
workstreams: Primary theory and ephemeris: distinguish bare, pair-effective, nominal and fitted GM; preserve source sign, observer/test-body composition and coordinate-time scaling.
Clock owner: identify signed potential template, phase, time standard, estimator and statistical/systematic uncertainty meaning; no overlapping-data averaging.
Freefall owner: identify fitted quantity, calibration, statistical/systematic combination and coverage meaning; no raw-data portal replay.
Hostile synthesis: test whether union-bound or moment-bound uncertainty propagation is justified by the actual supplied inputs rather than asserted Gaussianity or zero remainder.
acceptance: A usable operational calibration map plus source-qualified marginal coverage sets, including calibration/material/theory errors. Otherwise identify the precise unresolved input and preserve conditional/empirical distinctions. Source uncertainty statements need not be deterministic hard bounds, but their confidence meaning and assumptions must be explicit.
falsifier: An exact source-sign/normalization contradiction invalidates that import, not the unchanged model; lack of an error certificate is not an observational exclusion or a proof that no data exist.
exit: One synthesis record and independently checked source/calibration audit. No automatic successor; review the spent budget and state one evidence-based reentry condition.
non_claims: No empirical detection/exclusion or independent holdout, no TECT microscopic admission, no Pre-A/A/B/spacetime/QFT/GR/horizon/continuum/mass-gap/TOE conclusion. No replacement of pinned hashes or post-hoc contract adoption.
